clefairy.name: Clefairy
dialog: Clefairy is holding something shiny in both hands.

receptionist_west.name: Receptionist
dialog: Welcome to Amity Square! Take as long as you like.
Some trainers walk the paths with a Pokémon at their side. It does them both a world of good.

receptionist_east.name: Receptionist
dialog: This is Amity Square, where people and Pokémon come to unwind.
Keep an eye on the ground as you go. Visitors drop all sorts of things.

pokemon_breeder_m.name: Man
dialog: The old stones round this square were standing long before anyone built Hearthome.
Nobody knows who raised them. My Drifloon likes to float about them all afternoon.

pokemon_breeder_f.name: Woman
dialog: My Happiny and I come here every single day.
The fresh air does us both good. Then it naps all the way home.

collector.name: Man
dialog: All my life I dreamt of strolling round this park with a Pikachu.
And today, at last, here we are! I could burst!

twin.name: Girl
dialog: Do you talk to your Pokémon? You should!
My Clefairy understands every word I say. Well, nearly every word.

gift_man.name: Man
dialog: Good day to you! I walk in this park every day, rain or shine.
You never know what you'll find on the paths. Only this morning I came across a handful of Berries!
